title: Windows process preflight is global and does not recognize the supervisor executable
reasoning: The Windows branch returns every matching ClawPatch process without establishing its repository, so an unrelated repository can cause a false busy failure. Its PowerShell regex also omits clawpatch-supervise and clawpatch-supervise.exe, although the platform-independent detector recognizes them, creating a detection gap.
reproduction: On Windows, run clawpatch in repository A and check repository B; B is reported busy. A clawpatch-supervise.exe command does not match the current PowerShell regex.
recommendation: Establish each candidate's working directory and repository, reuse equivalent executable-recognition rules across platforms, and fail closed only when an actual candidate's ownership cannot be determined.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No Windows process-detection tests were linked or included.
suggestedRegressionTest: Mock same-repository clawpatch-supervise.exe, other-repository clawpatch.exe, and unrelated processes; assert only the same-repository supervisor is returned.
minimumFixScope: Replace or extend _windows_clawpatch_processes and add repository-scoping and executable-name tests.

history.reasoning: Original evidence remains present; current code and focused tests support the repair.
commands: ✅ Done — revalidated the Windows process-preflight finding as fixed in the current worktree.
